title: Junior Civil / Structural Engineer
abstract: Junior Civil/Structural Engineer providing forensic engineering and building diagnostic reporting services.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a Civil and Structural Engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you completed a qualification in civil construction?
content_text:
About the role
This role the core of the business activity of Silver Wolf Projects (Pty) Ltd. Successful candidates will engage directly with builders, insurance companies, loss adjusters, and clients to ensure that innovative, cost-effective engineering and remedial solutions are delivered on time. This is achieved through the provision of forensic civil/structural technical and building diagnostic reporting and scoping services.
Key responsibilities
- Site inspections
- Production of Engineering Reports, Scopes of Works and Design Plans
- Structural & Civil Design
- Technical Report Writing
- Use of Various Engineering Software Programs
- Building and BCA Documentation, Planning and Reporting
- AutoCAD/Revit drafting
- Deal with all clients and suppliers in a courteous and professional manner
- Comply with all company policies and procedures
- Maintain a clean and safe workspace and abide by workplace health and safety policies and procedures
About you
- B. Eng. (Civil or Structural), or Certificate IV in Engineering, or a degree in building or construction management
- Experience in onsite design for civil and residential buildings, or commercial building construction experience, or Building or Insurance Estimator
- Driving licence
- White Card
- Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook)
- AutoCAD and ReVit software skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication
- Organised and able to meet deadlines
- Understanding of the NCC, including the BCA
About us
Silver Wolf Projects (SWP) aims to ensure that buildings are compliant and safe, by offering dynamic, innovative engineering, building consulting and project management services, using the latest technology and service delivery methods to provide faster response times, keeping projects on time and on budget. We take pride in our reputation as being the team that delivers the right solution, quickly.
